steps.name: Traces of the Witch (1)
steps.objective: Talk to Theodore in "Guild Union City Esnil", then find [Shiina] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Only the finishing touches remain... But it's proving difficult.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Don't push yourself too hard. Mother asked me to thank you for what you did last time.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: No, I'm the grateful one. Tell Sister I appreciate her letting me teach the children.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I will! You're always welcome, Uncle Theo. Oh, %s! When did you get here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just now. Hello, Theo. Hello, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I have something to finish, so I'll leave you to talk.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: %s, seeing you here in Esnil tells me things went well in the Zisk Territory. I'm glad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, more or less. I'm just not sure how much I should tell you.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's all right. Lord Ziskad has promised to write to me, so don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I don't yet know what happened, but I can tell it was something significant. There's one thing that worries me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it...?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You know the Empire is watching you, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've found myself involved in its affairs.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I'm sure you're managing perfectly well without my advice, but please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: There's something I'm curious about. I hear you're acquainted with a mysterious minority people. Have you ever met anyone who looks like Narsha?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Narsha asked me about something she'd been wondering since she spoke with you. I imagine it will always be a question for her...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: But I don't know anything either, so I couldn't give her an answer. I'd appreciate it if you could tell her what you know sometime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd be happy to.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Where are you going now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have anywhere in particular to go. Since you're asking...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Yes. Princess Shiina at the magic academy... I mean, Shiina was looking for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to hide it anymore.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Still, isn't it more fun for those of us who know to keep up the act? Dayna really did a clumsy job of revealing her identity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, after what happened in Moros...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I had a good laugh when I heard. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Theo, won't you get arrested for insulting the imperial family?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Haha, we can't have that. Off you go to the magic academy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Theo. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why is Shiina looking for me? I wonder...)

steps.name: Traces of the Witch (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Veska] in the "Jewel Tree Forest" and obtain a <Tear of Light>. Then report to [Medea] in "Kali".

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer! Adventurer!
(The moment Shiina spots %s, she runs over and gives the adventurer a hug.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I missed you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. You startled me, running over like that.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh...
(Shiina steps back, looking embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I've gotten into the habit of hugging people lately without thinking.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I visited my middle sister and happened to tell Teacher Theo that I wanted to see you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But there's something else, too?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: My eldest sister sent a message. I'd like to tell her to deliver it herself, but... I can't quite do that. I can't disobey her orders. Hehe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It's about the witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: If my sister brought it up, you must know about her, right? I won't ask how.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It happened one night, a few days before my father passed away. A woman took me to them.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That woman was Daphne. She said she needed me and tried to take me into a dark place, but Kaina and Dayna stopped her.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The Moon's Scar knights helped, too.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Kaina seemed to know Daphne... Anyway, Daphne introduced herself as a witch, said she'd find another way, and told us to forget her.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The moment she said that, the knights and all three of us lost consciousness. When we woke, everyone had forgotten Daphne, as though they'd agreed to it. But...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow, I think you and your sisters, including Her Majesty, still remember.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, we do.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sometimes a child with special abilities is born into the imperial family... In our generation, all three of us...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: My eldest sister, my middle sister, and I... We're all a little unusual.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: ...My sister told us to pretend we'd lost our memories for the time being. When you asked about Daphne, I think I got flustered and let something slip...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Whew... That was a long story, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So there's something you must do. You need to awaken the memories of someone connected to Daphne. That's my sister's message.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone connected to Daphne... Medea...)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You seem to have someone in mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I should go right away. I happen to know how to do it...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should be thanking you. That can't have been easy to talk about.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It's all right, because I like you, Adventurer. And... I hope the memories of that person who knows the witch aren't anything terrible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, Shiina...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First, I'll look for a Tear of Light in the Jewel Tree Forest. I hope I can find one...)

steps.name: Traces of the Witch (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] in the "Divine Tree Lapier" and obtain a <Seed of Illusion>. Then report to [Medea] in "Kali".

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You have been through much in a short time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She seems to know I visited the Zisk Territory...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a few things happened.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems I learn these things whether I wish to or not.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Give me what you've brought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew. Here... A Tear of Light. W-wait! If you swallow it whole...
(Medea swallows the Tear of Light as soon as she receives it.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic really is dreadful, forcing you to eat this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-are you all right, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm fine. It doesn't taste good.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Daphne must have had something very significant to hide from me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. This isn't enough.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Humans live with their memories. Those memories can give them the will to keep living, or cause them to give up.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If they choose to keep living, those memories may remain as something comforting, even if they change to favor the person remembering them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That is how Lady Daphne remains in my mind. But whoever sent you here must feel differently about her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, please find one more thing for me. Very little has come back to me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's something you brought me before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A Seed of Illusion? I'll find one as quickly as I can.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, here's the Seed of Illusion.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, as always.
(Medea takes the Seed of Illusion and stares at it.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, while I prepare the medicine, would you fetch Beinan?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beinan? Is he in the village now?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Merimel is here, so he must have returned.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lately, he's been taking Merimel out of Adrica behind my back. I'm sure he's helping her meet Noel near Tartaros...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be too hard on him. Beinan can protect Merimel.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Saying one person will protect another is never a simple matter. If they cannot bear that responsibility...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry. That was uncalled for. In any case, Merimel must become stronger too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is something wrong?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll bring Beinan right away, Medea.
(Instead of making medicine, Medea swallows the Seed of Illusion whole.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Lady Daphne, what are you...?)
(A familiar voice sounds in Medea's ears.)
Medea.
Medea. Medea.
Medea. Medea. Medea.
Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea.
Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea.
Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea.
Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea. Medea!!!
You should never have uncovered this memory!!
Do you think your power came only from the sacrifice of your people?!!
(Images of an event surface again and again in Medea's mind, then shatter like glass.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wh-what... Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, come to your senses!

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Lady Medea! Lady Medea!
(Beinan helps Medea rise from where she has sunk to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That relentless, harsh voice... So ominous... Why would you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: N-no. %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, the Seed of Illusion... Did you swallow that whole too?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I-I'm fine. Now I... No. %s, please leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please leave!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry, but please do as Lady Medea asks and leave for today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel Beinan's killing intent... He looks ready to attack if I refuse to leave...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please. I beg you, leave for today. I... I will send for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Please rest. I'll come when you call.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is happening...?)
(Once she is sure %s has left Kali, Medea clings to Beinan and sobs.)

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Lady Medea? What is it...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Your memories of that time... You still have them, don't you, Beinan? You must.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The memories from just before you died...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Lady Medea, that's...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What, what happened back then?! What happened...?
